title: apricity-daw kit_notes.rs: a track's compiled notes to pad notes, with warnings
description:
## Intent

Turn one track's compiled notes into MIDI notes on the rack's pads.

## Scope

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/kit_notes.rs`: from `Timeline.events` of the track, group the events of one note (a note split at a chord change is one MIDI note), map `Event.piece` through `TrackInfo.pieces` to the pad and through M1's pad layout to the note; velocity from `Event.velocity` (100 when absent); start from `start_beat` in score time (bar 1 is beat 0), so the file lines up with the arrangement.
- Check the track plays the exported kit or one of its pads; build the warnings list for reverse, filter, speed, chord-following or auto transposition and track effects, each with the score location from the parser's source map.
- Confirm (and record in a comment) that gate and stutter reach the timeline as note lengths and extra notes; if one does not, add a warning for it rather than changing the compiler.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw
```
The kit-midi scenarios for notes, velocities, swing and bars pass.

## Release

`feat(<this task id>): a kit track's notes as pad notes`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the MIDI writer task.
